subject: MedSys - Request: HSM/KMS & Region Hosting Evidence for Hybrid VPC Deployment
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@medsys-health.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@medsys-health.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:03:22 -0700
Subject: Request: HSM/KMS separation + region hosting confirmation for pilot

Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As we scope the hybrid pilot for MedSys (US primary, EU failover), our security team has a few gating items before we can sign the SOW: 

1) Confirmation that customer keys can be partitioned and that Redwood supports HSM-backed KMS for private deployments (we need an architectural note and key-flow diagram).
2) Evidence that the private deployment will be physically hosted in designated regions (US East 1 and EU West 2) and that control-plane telemetry for the private install does not cross into other jurisdictions.
3) CAIQ or SIG-lite response and any SOC 2 references that apply to private/on-prem packages.

Can you share the CAIQ/SIG documents and a short runbook for private peering? We have a compliance review scheduled for Jun 29 and would like the materials by EOD Jun 23 if possible.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Grant
Sr. Information Security Manager | MedSys Health
O: +1 415-555-0123

--
Attachment: medsys-questionnaire.xlsx (Excel, 28 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@medsys-health.com>
Cc: compliance@medsys-health.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:18:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: HSM/KMS separation + region hosting confirmation for pilot

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide an evidence packet for the pilot. Quick clarifications so we scope the packet correctly:

- When you say “HSM-backed KMS for private deployments”, do you need on-prem HSM recommendations (customer-managed) or verification that Redwood’s Private deployment can integrate with a customer KMS/HSM via KMIP/Cloud KMS connectors?
- For telemetry/control-plane scope: are you asking for a network egress diagram (what leaves the private control plane) or a legal/data residency commitment?

I’ll pull the CAIQ + SIG-lite and a compact architecture diagram — proposing to deliver:
- CAIQ response (redacted where needed)
- VPC architecture diagram for hybrid (showing peering + private link)
- KMS/HSM integration note and key partitioning statement
- Private peering/runbook summary

Internal team: looping in Irene and Monica to prepare the packet — Irene on KMS/HSM detail and Monica on network/runbook. Steph, can you confirm SOC 2 references we can include for Private customers?

Targeting an initial bundle by EOD Jun 22 so you have one day to review before the Jun 23 deadline. If we need extra redactions or an NDA, let me know.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:23:41 -0700
Subject: FW: Request: HSM/KMS separation + region hosting confirmation for pilot

Team — see inbound from MedSys (Olivia). Need a tight evidentiary bundle for a compliance review. Please do the following: 

Irene — provide a one-page KMS/HSM integration note that covers:
- Supported modes: customer-managed cloud KMS (AWS KMS/CloudHSM), on-prem HSM via KMIP, and Redwood-managed keys for hosted API.
- Key partitioning/tenant separation statement (how we ensure tenant key isolation in Private and Dedicated modes).
- Example keyflow diagram (PDF or PNG).

Monica — provide network diagram and a 2-page private-peering runbook showing:
- VPC topology (US primary, EU standby), peering endpoints, routing controls, and egress restrictions.
- Steps for establishing private peering and required customer firewall config.

Steph — confirm which SOC 2 appendix/pages we can reference for Private deployments and whether a redacted SOC 2 attestation PDF can be provided to this prospect.

Deadline: EOD Tue Jun 22 for an initial bundle. If you hit blockers (legal redactions, export control concerns for HSM docs), flag me immediately.

Thanks — K

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:12:30 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Request: HSM/KMS separation + region hosting confirmation for pilot

Karthik / Irene — working on this now. Quick status: 

- VPC architecture diagram: draft attached (vpc-architecture-diagram.png). Shows US East 1 primary, EU West 2 standby, explicit peering links, and an administrative bastion for control-plane access.
- Private peering runbook: draft attached (private-peering-runbook.md). Includes checklist for pre-reqs on customer side, required BGP tags, and IP whitelisting.
- Egress statement: included inline on page 2; control-plane telemetry endpoints are confined to the assigned region except for optional usage reporting to the Redwood control plane (opt-in).

Attachments (drafts):
- vpc-architecture-diagram.png (PNG, 340 KB)
- private-peering-runbook.md (Markdown, 12 KB)

Irene — if you can drop the KMS keyflow and tenant separation note by noon I’ll assemble the packet and push to the secure drive link Karthik requested.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@medsys-health.com>
Cc: compliance@medsys-health.com, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 15:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: HSM/KMS separation + region hosting confirmation for pilot

Olivia — attaching the initial evidence packet for your compliance review. Files are in the secure folder below; we included redacted CAIQ responses and a SIG-lite summary. If you need full SIG/CAT exports, we can provide them under an NDA.

Secure evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cmedsys-evidence
Redwood evidence bundle (attachments):
- redwood-caiq-2026-06.pdf (PDF, 48 KB) — CAIQ with redactions for internal-only items
- vpc-architecture-diagram.png (PNG, 340 KB) — hybrid VPC diagram
- kms-key-partitioning-statement.pdf (PDF, 22 KB) — HSM/KMS integration and tenant key isolation statement
- private-peering-runbook.md (MD, 12 KB) — operational checklist for peering

Notes / commitments:
- Key management: Private deployments support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS + CloudHSM) and on-prem KMIP-compatible HSMs; our KMS integration patterns are documented in the attached KMS statement. Tenant keys are cryptographically separated; Redwood does not hold private key material for customer-managed HSMs.
- Residency & telemetry: For Private installs we will commit to hosting inference workload within the customer-designated regions (US East 1 and EU West 2). Control-plane telemetry can be limited to the local region; global optional reporting is opt-in and requires customer consent in the setup form.
- SOC 2: Stephanie has confirmed we can share a redacted SOC 2 attestation for sales/procurement review; we will surface the applicable page references in the final packet.

Next steps: If this aligns with MedSys needs, we can deliver an expanded SIG export and/or schedule a short walkthrough (20–30 min) with our infra/security SME to walk through the architecture and KMS flows. Do you want the walkthrough before your Jun 29 review or after?

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood-caiq-2026-06.pdf (PDF), kms-key-partitioning-statement.pdf (PDF), vpc-architecture-diagram.png (PNG), private-peering-runbook.md (MD)
